dialogue.speech: the switch to make the seat recline.

dialogue.speech: If I push it, the seat will lean back.

dialogue.speech: That thing will probably attack this seat before the brooch.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Th-Then I can grab the brooch and head into the c*ck...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: B-But I can't!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I can't make a wager like that!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's far too dangerous.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I need to just hide in the closet...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What's wrong with me?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Do I even realize what I'm doing?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Unbelievable.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I didn't want to take the risk, but I still pushed the button!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Now I just have to do it.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The path to the c*ck is wide open!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Move...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: slowly...

dialogue.speech: Just like the tai chi that the Chinese practice...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I can't rush.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: If I rush, I'll die!

dialogue.speech: It's heading back this way!

dialogue.speech: How did my boots get wet?

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I should've just stayed out of this!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: S-Save me, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: M-My boot just fell over next to my foot.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's like it went through my foot...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wait, what?

dialogue.speech: What just happened?

dialogue.speech: Wh-Who's there?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Is someone there?

dialogue.speech: I've always been here,

dialogue.speech: ever since you were little.

dialogue.speech: I've always been by your side.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Trish, please pick up that brooch.

dialogue.speech: That's the decision you've made.

dialogue.name: Spice

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wh-Who are you?

dialogue.speech: I am you.

dialogue.speech: I'm also the one who got the thing off of your boot just now.

dialogue.speech: I am your ability.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Now, if you've made your decision, please pick it up.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: You and I are going to protect

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Giorno's left hand!

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Trish, if we're able to protect it,

dialogue.name: Spice

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Pick it up, Trish!

dialogue.speech: I'm finished!

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: This is your ability.

dialogue.speech: I made the seat softer.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wh-What just...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I literally slipped right through the seat.

dialogue.speech: And it somehow damaged that thing.

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: That thing managed to stop Mista's b*ll*ts and catch up to this plane.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It has the ability to destroy things that are fast.

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Are you... me?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Was I the one who just did this?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The thing with the boot, too. Was that—

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: What's important right now, Trish,

dialogue.speech: is that you picked up the brooch.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Your strong determination overpowered any hesitation.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: You are becoming stronger, both mentally and as a person.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: And you are able to make anything in this world softer, more elastic.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Making things softer...

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: means they become harder to break than diamonds!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-It's coming again!

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: This time, stay still.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I'm starting to understand that you're me, but I have to hide!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Make the closet door soft!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Please make it in time!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Damn it! Stay the hell away until I close this door!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-It managed to find me on the other side of the door, even though I'm hiding!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-I'm done for!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I'm starting to understand that I'm a Stand user and have Stand abilities...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: B-But...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: This thing's invincible!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The user is already dead, too. No one can defeat this thing!

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Trish, I asked you not to move.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: We have to head to the c*ck, where Bucciarati is,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but we went in the opposite direction.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What are you talking about?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Giorno's brooch is developing into his left hand and moving.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I had to run away!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: But your ability...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: All it does is make things softer!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's taking all I have to evade these attacks!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-It's going to get me!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-It attacked the clock again?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: I made the clock more elastic.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: As long as you don't move faster than the second hand on that clock,

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: it'll continue to respond to the second hand

dialogue.name: JoJo-main

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: When I said not to move, I just meant to move slowly.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Move slowly.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: Slower than the second hand.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: At super slow speed...

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: But with the strength of a vise.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: We're going to rip this thing apart...

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: and k*ll it.

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: You b*stard! Just go to hell already!

dialogue.name: Spice
dialogue.speech: You piece of sh*t! Quit latching on to this world, damn it!

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.speech: Do you have a name?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What should I call you?

dialogue.name: Spice

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I see...

dialogue.speech: And I don't know why!

dialogue.speech: But what are we supposed to do?

dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, what are you—

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Don't panic, no matter what.

dialogue.name: Bruno

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Th-That's...

dialogue.speech: No! Th-That's impossible!

dialogue.speech: It's no use! We just keep falling!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: At this rate, we're going to crash!

dialogue.speech: Actually, the engines are likely to explode before that!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Th-That thing should've been torn into pieces and disintegrated...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: W-Wait, the engines are right behind the closet.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Oh, no...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: If even a tiny part of this thing melded into the wall of the closet...

dialogue.speech: We need to make an emergency landing, Abbacchio.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We need to make an emergency landing on the water.

dialogue.speech: It's the only choice we have!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's invincible. It's too powerful.

dialogue.speech: It's an invincible ability!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Now, slowly, Trish...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Slowly, like a slug. Don't panic.

dialogue.speech: Don't run, whatever you do!

dialogue.speech: If I do something as lame as moving slow, it's going to catch up to me anyway!

dialogue.speech: Get in the c*ck, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Spicy Lady!

dialogue.speech: T-Trish... This is... When did you obtain Stand abilities?

dialogue.speech: If that thing is going to prioritize speed in its attacks,

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: A plane crashing is way faster

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Yes! You stupid b*stard!

dialogue.speech: Right?

dialogue.speech: The organization's lost track of us.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Time to track down the boss's true identity and find him!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: No, Abbacchio.

dialogue.speech: I'll get rid of that thing.

dialogue.name: Abba

dialogue.speech: There's no way to k*ll this thing.

dialogue.speech: B-Bucciarati, you can't mean... D-Don't do it!

dialogue.speech: You're going to wrap that thing onto your arm?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Don't! Are you going to take yourself out of this, too?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: No, Abbacchio.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No one else is going to get hurt.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Giorno's Golden Wind ability

dialogue.name: Trish

dialogue.speech: Wh-When did you...

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Complete annihilation: impossible.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Forced to track the crashing waves of the sea forever.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: At times, it attacks ships that happen to move faster than the waves and sinks them.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: and considered ominous.

dialogue.speech: We're going to track down my father's past!

dialogue.speech: This mystery has yet to be solved.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I thought I'd made it disappear,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: but one's past wraps itself around one's true peace, never letting go.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Unbelievable. This is why blood relations are so troublesome.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: It wouldn't be concerning if it involved a stranger,

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: but once blood relations are involved, things become tricky.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: But that's all it is.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: It's just a blood relation. If I can get rid of that,

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I'll be able to remain in the prime of my life.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Several days ago, after Pericolo secured Trish,

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: the traitors who were after her scoured this apartment that Trish and her mother lived in,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: but none of them noticed.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Every morning of her life,Trish awoke in this house...

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: And...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Every day, she looked at this picture that her mother had lovingly put up.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: But this date... There's no doubt about it.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: It's fifteen years ago.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: This portrait... Even I almost missed it.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: To think that such a thing existed...

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Their plane crashed... but they're alive.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I can feel it...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: My daughter's Stand abilities have awakened.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I can also tell that she's alive and heading to Sardinia.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: And if it was Abbacchio's Moody Jazz that was flying the plane,

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: that means he's also alive, at the very least.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I can't let Moody Jazz go to the spot in this picture.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Trish might not realize it right now, but she'll surely remember

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: the existence of this picture.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: And if she goes to Sardinia, she'll figure out

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: that the person who took this portrait of her mother when she was young

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: was me!

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I can't let Moody Jazz's ability replay that!

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I'll have to go there myself.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I have to do it myself.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I can't let any of my subordinates attempt to handle this.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.speech: Why was I here again?
